# `unreachable-public-declaration`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a public declaration outside every successfully compiler-analyzed
compile unit's import graph.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Public-looking code outside every build root is neither compiled nor available
to consumers.

## When it fires

This opt-in project diagnostic stays silent unless every discovered build root
was analyzed successfully and the source import graph has no unresolved
build-named module edge.
